name: Nginx UI
description: Manages Nginx from a web UI and an MCP interface, so agents can edit config files, reload or restart Nginx, and check its status.

skills.name: Manage Nginx Configs
skills.description: Lists, reads, creates, modifies and renames Nginx configuration files and directories through MCP tools for AI agents.

skills.name: Control Nginx Service
skills.description: Reloads or restarts Nginx and reports its running status from an MCP client, with no shell access to the server.

skills.name: Let's Encrypt Certificates
skills.description: Deploys Let's Encrypt certificates in one click and renews them automatically for the sites Nginx serves.

skills.name: Config Backups
skills.description: Backs up configuration automatically after each change, with version comparison and one-step restore.

skills.name: Cluster Management
skills.description: Mirrors configuration operations to multiple Nginx nodes to manage multi-server environments from one panel.
